faq.headline: System Integration & Technology Solutions in Saudi Arabia
faq.body:
RCS Arabia is a system integration and technology solutions company serving organizations across Saudi Arabia and the GCC. With more than 30 years of experience, we deliver specialized solutions across ICT system integration, ELV and smart technologies, AI and digital twins, data centers, audio visual systems, smart airport technologies, healthcare and hospitality solutions, and renewable energy.

Our capabilities extend beyond technology implementation. Through project management, engineering consultancy, construction planning, project controls, commercial management, and integrated Civil, MEP and ELV solutions, we support complex projects throughout their lifecycle.

By combining specialized expertise, strategic technology partnerships, and regional project experience, RCS Arabia helps organizations build connected, efficient, secure, and future-ready environments.
faq.q1: What system integration services does RCS Arabia provide in Saudi Arabia?
faq.a1: RCS Arabia provides end-to-end system integration services across ICT infrastructure, ELV systems, smart buildings, data centers, audio visual solutions, AI and digital twin technologies, and renewable energy. We integrate multiple technology systems and disciplines to deliver complete, reliable solutions for complex projects across Saudi Arabia and the GCC.
faq.q2: Does RCS Arabia provide project management services alongside technology solutions?
faq.a2: Yes. RCS Arabia combines technology solutions with specialized project management capabilities including PMO, construction planning, commercial management, claims advisory, and integrated civil, MEP and ELV coordination. This enables us to support clients from planning through to project completion.
faq.q3: Which industries does RCS Arabia serve across Saudi Arabia and the GCC?
faq.a3: RCS Arabia serves organizations across real estate, construction, oil and gas, manufacturing, healthcare, hospitality, transportation and airports, and government and public infrastructure. Our multidisciplinary capabilities enable us to support organizations where technology, infrastructure, and operational reliability are critical.
